name: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
where: Round Rock, TX · Old Settlers Park
headline: Texas: El Paso Eastwood ends Southlake Carroll’s run
summary: No. 6 El Paso Eastwood won the UIL 6A boys title with 56 points, ahead of No. 3 Southlake Carroll (68), the seven-time defending champion, and Keller (109). It is the first 6A boys title for a team outside Southlake Carroll, The Woodlands and Kingwood in 21 years. Denton Guyer’s Ruel Newberry won the individual race in 14:36.3, with Eastwood’s Noah Garcia third (14:40.4) and Southlake Carroll’s Kai Gutierrez fifth (14:43.1). Flower Mound won the 6A girls title with 68 points over The Woodlands (125), and Katy Tompkins’ Bailey Pipes won in 17:20.5.
